coverage.note: Derived from the input file at build time. Games not final in the source are absent; check nflverse schedules for pending games at integration time.

classification_checks.note: Sacks are pass; scrambles are run and excluded from pass split. No-play rows excluded; live scrimmage penalties retained.

definitions.accepted_plays: play_type in {pass, run}; two_point_attempt excluded; kneels/spikes are distinct play_type values removed by that filter; sacks are pass; scrambles are run
definitions.epa: nflfastR modeled epa; null epa excluded from EPA metrics only
definitions.opponent_adjustment: one weighted ridge per metric over team-game rows; features intercept + home + offense dummy + defense dummy; penalty 20 on team effects only; adjusted = intercept + effect
definitions.rank_direction: offense descending (higher better); defense ascending (lower allowed better)
definitions.denominators: per side: offensive columns use posteam plays, defensive columns use defteam plays; they differ by team
definitions.splits: pass/run filters computed separately with own regressions and per-side play counts
